purpose: Freeze the measurement family after exact source-vintage retention and before any behavioural fitting. This contract selects an observed NFC investment-intensity target and exact source/transform boundaries for demand, financing cost and investment-grant support. It does not admit a behavioural equation, choose lag structure, open a calibration cycle, inspect an evaluation holdout or activate System Dynamics feedback.

evidence_basis.target_definition: Eurostat/ECB quarterly sector accounts define the NFC gross investment rate as gross fixed capital formation divided by gross value added.
evidence_basis.d92_definition: ESA 2010 D.92 investment grants are capital transfers by government or the rest of the world to finance fixed-asset acquisition; EU institutions can be among rest-of-world payers, but aggregate D.92 does not identify EU origin.
evidence_basis.investment_driver_scope: Demand and financing conditions are retained as candidate explanatory families because they are independently documented investment-relevant channels; this contract treats them as predictive/associational observables, not identified causal shocks.

primary_target.concept: Romania non-financial-corporation gross fixed capital formation as a ratio of NFC gross value added, quarterly
primary_target.reason: This exact sector-specific observed target avoids importing a non-sector-specific investment deflator into an S11 behavioural target.
primary_target.semantic_boundary: This is investment intensity, not investment growth. The legacy gI growth form is not estimated in this cycle.

excluded_target_for_this_cycle.reason: Exact S11 GFCF is nominal/current-price and no sector-specific real-investment deflator has been retained. Choosing a deflator after model outcomes would violate the measurement boundary.
excluded_target_for_this_cycle.reopening_rule: A future gI cycle requires a separately preregistered sector-consistent real/volume measurement bridge and untouched evaluation design.

demand_measurement.source_concept: Romania real GDP, chain-linked volume, calendar and seasonally adjusted, quarterly, millions of euro
demand_measurement.reason: Use an economy-wide real-demand/activity observable rather than NFC GVA growth, because NFC GVA is the denominator of the selected investment-rate target.
demand_measurement.unit_boundary: EUR CHAIN-LINKED VOLUME IS USED AS THE DIRECTLY VERIFIED PROVIDER SERIES; YEAR-ON-YEAR GROWTH IS INVARIANT TO A FIXED SCALAR UNIT CONVERSION
demand_measurement.source_verification: ECB Data Portal series page directly confirms the exact key and adjustment/price semantics.

financing_cost_measurement.source_concept: RON new-business lending rate to non-financial corporations
financing_cost_measurement.reason: Retain the directly observed marginal nominal financing-cost measure instead of inventing a real-rate deflator or treating it as the effective cost on the outstanding debt stock.

investment_support_measurement.label: investment_grants_support_intensity
investment_support_measurement.reason: D.92 is sector-consistent investment support but the aggregate recipient-side series does not identify payer origin.

timing_and_lag_boundary.rule: No lag, distributed-lag, autoregressive order, sign gate or interaction may be chosen until a separate structural-selection contract is frozen before fit.

required_outputs: exact retained raw/normalized S11 GVA source
exact retained raw/normalized real GDP source
offline-reproducible quarterly NFC new-business lending-rate mean
